post.description: Registers the letter and sends it in one step: generates tracking_number, sets created_by to the caller, status=send, and notifies received_by. Writes an audit log. The letter and its files travel in ONE multipart request: when the user picks source_type uploaded or scanned in the front end, the file(s) are sent in the `files` field of this same request (there are no separate file endpoints). With source_type=generated no file is sent and the response has `"files": []`.
